edges.reason: transfer forwards its _to argument into transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value argument into transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as _from and as the allowance spender identity inside transferFrom.
approve writes allowance keyed by msg.sender, letting the caller grant arbitrary allowances.
_spender parameter is stored in the allowance mapping.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
transferFrom passes _from into ensure.
transferFrom passes _to into ensure.
transferFrom passes _value into ensure.
ensure forwards _from to condition.
ensure forwards _value to condition.
canSale[_from] acts as a caller-supplied whitelist gate in ensure.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to limit sales per address.
owner is compared against _from/_to in ensure, granting a full bypass of sale conditions.
tradeAddress value participates in the ensure whitelist check.
Constant UNI router address is whitelisted in ensure.
Locally derived _UNI pair address is compared against _from in ensure.
condition enforces _minSale against the transfer amount.
condition enforces _maxSale against the transfer amount.
condition compares _saleNum with _onSaleNum[_from].
Untrusted address parameter a is the target of the delegatecall.
Untrusted bytes parameter b becomes the delegatecall payload.
delegate gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
init gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
init sets _minSale from the token parameter.
init sets _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init sets _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend iterates over the caller-supplied recipient array.
batchSend uses _value for each credit and for the total computation.
Each recipient _tos[i] is copied into the loop-local _to.
Loop index i selects the recipient written to the local _to.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is an unchecked raw addition of a user-supplied amount.
setTradeAddress writes the caller-supplied addr into the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
setTradeAddress gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
pairFor hashes the factory argument into the pair address.
pairFor orders and hashes tokenA.
pairFor orders and hashes tokenB.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting full privileged control to the deployer.
totalSupply is computed from _supply multiplied by 10**decimals.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] using raw arithmetic.
transfer unconditionally delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
delegate reaches the delegatecall unsafe operation.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance arithmetic operations.
The arbitrary delegatecall executes untrusted code inside this contract's storage context, allowing it to overwrite the owner slot and re-enter privileged state changes.
